brief_text: A tool that turns university lecture notes into revision cards
key_advantage: Automatically extracts key points and generates quizzes
hook: Stop staring at a wall of lecture notes during exam week 📚
body: Drop in your lecture notes and get key ideas, concepts and practice questions in one place. It is useful for a quick review before an exam and for finding gaps in your understanding.
cta: Try it and make revision a little less stressful.

brief_text: A tool that turns university lecture notes into revision cards
key_advantage: Automatically extracts key points and generates quizzes
hook: Turn lecture notes into revision-ready knowledge cards
body: For university students who need to revise within limited time, the tool extracts core concepts from lecture notes and generates structured cards and self-check questions. This helps users identify weak areas more quickly.
cta: Start organising your first set of notes.

brief_text: A tool that turns university lecture notes into revision cards
key_advantage: Automatically extracts key points and generates quizzes
hook: In 30 seconds: turn lecture notes into revision cards
body: Open the tool and upload your lecture notes. It extracts the key points, then creates cards and a short quiz. Instead of reading from page one to the last page, you can practise the areas that need the most attention.
cta: Save this for your next revision session.
